affordance_in_statement: For every joint venture ... 2(f_u - f_v)^4 - 10(f_u - f_v)^2 + 4; ... the total sum ... equals exactly -4m.
removal_suggestion: There is no semantics-preserving wording change that removes this reduction: for labels 1, 2, 3, the interaction is 4 when endpoints match and -4 otherwise, so equality to -4m intrinsically means every edge has differently labeled endpoints. To defeat the shortcut, the metric or target must be changed or re-presented so the target is not the per-edge minimum.

common_affordance: The polynomial has value -4 for every unequal pair of labels and +4 for equal labels, while -4m is the absolute per-edge minimum; therefore every edge must have different labels, yielding ordinary 3-colorability.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Enumerates all 3^n assignments with itertools.product and checks every edge, causing TLE at n up to 40.

recommended_edit: If changing the mathematical presentation is permitted, replace the uniform interaction expression and extremal target -4m with a nonuniform, non-extremal aggregate metric so satisfying the total no longer forces every edge to use different agencies.
